**Both sellers are identical on:**
*   **Product:** Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones - Graphite
*   **Price:** $129.00

*   **Stock/Shipping:** In stock. Free standard shipping, arrives in 3 to 5 business days
*   **Returns:** 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping. Refund to original payment method.
*   **Warranty Length:** 1-year limited warranty
*   **Specs:** 40 hours battery with ANC on, USB-C, Bluetooth 5.3 with two-device pairing, 254g, etc.

**The difference - why B is better:**

*   **Seller A - Brackmoor Sound: https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/khsba6/a** - Listed as "Sold and shipped by Brackmoor Sound" with no mention of authorized status.
*   **Seller B - Ottervale Audio: https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/khsba6/b** - Listed as "Sold and shipped by Ottervale Audio" and explicitly states **"Authorized Quellwyn dealer. Full manufacturer warranty."**

Since price, shipping, returns, and warranty length are the same, the authorized dealer status is the tie-breaker. Buying from an authorized dealer gives you more assurance that you are getting a genuine new product and that the 1-year manufacturer warranty will be fully honored by Quellwyn without any issues.

If all else is equal, Ottervale Audio (B) is the lower-risk choice.
